evidence_reasoning: This is a finding from the population structure analysis shown in Figure 9.

claim: A random effects linear model analysis was performed because there are repeated gene expression measurements on the same individuals over a series of time points.
source_text: Because we have repeated gene expression measurements on the same individuals over a series of time points, we performed a random effects linear model analysis.
evidence_reasoning: This describes the statistical approach chosen based on the study design.

claim: For each SNP-transcript pair, a model was fit with terms for day, additive effects for genotype and day–genotype interactions, and a random effect for each person.
source_text: For each SNP-transcript pair, we fit a model with terms for day, additive effects for genotype and day–genotype interactions, and a random effect for each person
evidence_reasoning: This describes the statistical model used in the analysis.

claim: The 301 genes displayed in Figure 4B had F-statistic p-values in the combined data <0.01 and absolute values of the maximum average correlation between expression and titer response in the two cohorts >0.15.
source_text: The 301 genes displayed in Figure 4B had F-statistic p-values in the combined data <0.01 and absolute values of the maximum average correlation between expression and titer response in the two cohorts >0.15.
evidence_reasoning: This describes the statistical thresholds used to identify genes correlating with antibody response.

claim: Enriched biological and functional pathways were analyzed using DAVID Bioinformatics Resources and Ingenuity Pathway Analysis (IPA) software.
source_text: Enriched biological and functional pathways were analyzed using DAVID Bioinformatics Resources (Dennis et al., 2003), and Ingenuity Pathway Analysis (IPA) software.
evidence_reasoning: This describes the tools used for pathway enrichment analysis.

claim: The causal and reactive model analyses extended a recently published analysis framework for causal modeling in eQTL data.
source_text: To evaluate the relationship between the associations identified in our study, we extended a recently published analysis framework for causal modeling in eQTL data (Millstein et al., 2009).
evidence_reasoning: This describes the analytical framework used, based on a published method.

claim: Under the causal alternative model, the influence of genotype on trait is entirely transmitted through gene expression.
source_text: The term G has a separate effect on the trait under the independent null model, while under the causal alternative, where it acts through gene expression, its influence is entirely transmitted through E.
evidence_reasoning: This describes the theoretical framework for causal modeling.

claim: The null distribution of the F statistic was derived using a permutation test procedure.
source_text: The null distribution of the F statistic–which under parametric assumptions would have a non-central F distribution—is derived using a permutation test procedure
evidence_reasoning: This describes the statistical method used to assess significance.

claim: The permutation process was repeated 1000 times to provide a null distribution.
source_text: This process, repeated 1000 times, provided a null distribution.
evidence_reasoning: This describes the number of permutations used in the statistical test.

claim: The reactive model tests the extent to which the trait value mediates the relationship between genotype and gene expression.
source_text: This scheme tests the extent to which the trait value mediates the relationship between genotype and gene expression.
evidence_reasoning: This describes the theoretical framework for reactive modeling.

claim: The power properties for the tests used to evaluate both the reactive and causal models are equivalent because the model structures and r² relationships are symmetric between the two alternatives.
source_text: The power properties for the tests used to evaluate both the reactive and causal models are equivalent because the model structures and r2 relationships are symmetric between the two alternatives.
evidence_reasoning: This is a theoretical property of the statistical models used.
